name: My Hero
source:
In this world of superheroes, you play as Eve; a normal, school girl living her mundane life in the Philippines. You then come across a familiar face — Ethan, known to be the quiet and shy type. You know about him just as much as Eve does. As Eve goes on about her day, she thinks nothing much about what might change... until it does.

At that moment, she sees a bus coming towards Ethan a little too fast.  And she is too late. With Ethan in a comatose, Eve visits  him at the hospital and finds a strange, red notebook that stands out from the rest of his things. Eventually, the secret is revealed to you that Ethan is a hero himself. 

But what will you do when Ethan is awake and suddenly remembers nothing from before the accident? 

Will you tell him everything, or nothing?

[From [url=https://axoloteagames.itch.io/my-hero-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个超级英雄的世界里，你扮演夏娃；一名普通的女学生，在菲律宾过着平凡的生活。然后你会遇到一张熟悉的面孔——伊森（Ethan），他是众所周知的安静害羞的人。你和夏娃一样了解他。当夏娃继续她的一天时，她对可能发生的事情并没有太多的思考……直到事情发生。

就在那时，她看到一辆公共汽车朝伊森驶来，速度有点太快了。而她已经太迟了。伊森昏迷不醒，伊芙去医院探望他，并发现了一本奇怪的红色笔记本，它从他的其他东西中脱颖而出。最终，这个秘密向你揭晓：伊森本人就是英雄。

但是，当伊森醒来并突然记不起事故发生前的任何事情时，你会怎么做？

你会告诉他一切，还是什么也不告诉他？

[来自[url=https://axoloteagames.itch.io/my-hero-demo]itch.io[/url]]
